APPROVE
The extractions (`WorkspaceDirsByName`, `TransitiveWorkspaceDeps`, `IsUnder`, `ChangeFilterSite`) move the nested loops and conditions out verbatim, which brings `ChangeFilters` to about 15, and the flipped `reported.Add` check behaves the same as the old `continue`; I couldn't find the repository here, though, so I haven't confirmed that the parameter types `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation` and `JsInventory.Inventory` exist under those names or that `IsUnder` doesn't clash with another member of the partial class.
